title: A Dance with Dragons
author: George R.R. Martin
summary: The fifth book of A Song of Ice and Fire returns to the full cast of viewpoints across a continent still at war. Dangers gather at the Wall, a young queen struggles to rule a restless foreign city, and old players pursue their own plans.
readIf: you have followed the series this far and want its fullest, most sprawling volume so far.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, or can't tolerate a series that is still unfinished.

pairings.reason: Another long, many-volume epic where the world keeps expanding and prophecies shape every faction.
A single-volume epic of political resistance and occupation, with far more emotional focus than battles.
Offers war told from inside the ranks, grim and morally grey, with fewer pages and a gritty tone.
